sources.title: Naturalistic illustrative FPV scene
sources.method: Built-in image_gen in generation mode. A new everyday apartment scene at toy-camera height with neutral daylight and restrained small-sensor detail. Generated illustration, not live car footage.
sources.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: a replacement 16:9 illustrative FPV video frame for a tiny indoor RC car app README. Generate ONLY the room camera image; the actual application HUD will be composited separately.
Primary request: an unremarkable, believable frame from a cheap wide-angle toy camera mounted 3 centimeters above the floor in an ordinary lived-in apartment. It should resemble paused consumer camera footage, not an interior-design photograph or an AI architectural render.
Scene: simple matte light oak laminate flooring, an off-white wall with a normal skirting board, the side of a plain dining chair at the left edge, an ordinary gray fabric sofa farther away, and an open doorway. Spatially coherent furniture, straight physical walls, normal chair-leg geometry, modest untidy everyday wear, subtle floor scuffs and natural material variation. Keep the middle of the floor passable and uncluttered.
Composition: landscape 16:9, camera truly at toy-car height, looking almost horizontally across the floor, normal wide-angle perspective with slight lens barrel distortion. Deep focus from the middle distance onward; no shallow-focus portrait bokeh, no giant blurred foreground. Floor in the lower half, furniture and wall in the upper half.
Lighting/style: soft flat overcast daylight, neutral white balance, subdued natural colors, slightly limited dynamic range, modest small-sensor grain and faint compression softness. A candid practical camera view with imperfect everyday detail, not gritty or degraded. No golden light, glossy wood reflections, bloom, perfect symmetrical styling, dramatic sunbeams, cinematic color grading, oversharpening, illustration, CGI, or 3D rendering.
Constraints: full bleed standalone camera frame, no HUD, no crosshair, no text, no timestamp, no numbers, no borders, no device, no visible vehicle, no logo, no watermark.

sources.title: Driver HUD over illustrative scene
sources.method: Rendered by mpv/libass using ASS output from the unchanged HUD drawing functions in drive.mjs over the new generated scene. Static demonstration state: 35% throttle, -10% steering, trim 0, REC 00:27, UDP 25 FPS. Courier New keeps the earlier screenshot typography. The scene is scaled/cropped proportionally to 1280x720; the same HUD frame feeds the app window, Steam Deck display and later HUD image. No driver session or car connection was started. This is not live car footage.
